name: All Suite Resorts Paznaun
beschreibung:
The All Suite Resorts Paznaun in Galtür, Tirol, offers exclusive accommodation with modern and tastefully furnished suites. The resorts are located in a quiet and idyllic setting, just a few minutes from the gondola lift and the center of Galtür.

Guests can choose between various suite types, all equipped with a kitchen to allow self-catering. The atmosphere is quiet and relaxing, ideal for a restful vacation in the mountains.

The All Suite Resorts Paznaun also offers various lifts and lift facilities to explore the area and enjoy the surrounding nature.
